openrn-fund10-2.basis_question:
You are a nurse working in a long-term care facility. You have been assigned to care for Mr. Johns, a 74-year-old client recently diagnosed with a urinary tract infection, resulting in frequent incontinence. Mr. Johns suffered a CVA (stroke) six months ago and has difficulties ambulating and attending to his own needs because of weakness on his right side. Mr. Johns is alert and oriented to person, place, and time, but has decreased sensation on his entire right side. He spends most of his time in bed or sitting at his bedside in a wheelchair due to his difficulty with ambulation. He eats about 50% of his meals. While assessing Mr. Johns, you note that he is thin for his height, incontinent of foul-smelling urine, and has a deepened reddened area on his sacrum.

What factors make him particularly vulnerable to the development of pressure injuries?
openrn-fund10-2.basis_answer: Individual factors that increase vulnerability to pressure injury development include weakness, diminished sensation (related to his stroke), diminished mobility, frequent incontinence, and decreased nutritional intake.

openrn-skills14-1.basis_question:
Mr. Curtis is a 47-year-old patient admitted with a one-week history of progressive fatigue and ongoing diarrhea. You are completing his admission assessment.
Based upon his presenting condition, what integumentary assessments might be important?
openrn-skills14-1.basis_answer: A patient admitted with diarrhea is at risk for skin breakdown and dehydration. Assessment of the patient’s skin condition and hydration status would be important for assessing the severity of the patient’s illness. Hydration status can be assessed through evaluation of skin turgor with this patient due to normal skin elasticity in this age group.

openrn-skills20-1a.basis_question:
Mr. Jones is a 76-year-old patient admitted to the medical surgical floor with complications of a nonhealing foot ulcer. Mr. Jones has a history of diabetes, hypertension, and COPD. He has a BMI of 29. His daily medications include metformin, Lisinopril, and prednisone. His wife has recently passed away and he lives alone.

Based upon what is known about Mr. Jones, what factors might be contributing to his nonhealing wound?
openrn-skills20-1a.basis_answer: Mr. Jones has a history of diabetes, is overweight, takes a corticosteroid, and has had a recent life stressor. These factors may all be contributory to the lack of wound healing.

incorrect.zh: 饮食/蛋白摄入未知，不得当作患者已确定缺乏或充足。
incorrect.en: Diet/protein intake is unknown; do not treat deficiency or adequacy as established.

Teach oxygen safety
Assess lung sounds
Assess pulse oximetry
openrn-skills11-1.basis_answer:
Priority
Actions
First
Assess pulse oximetry
Second
Assess lung sounds
Third
Apply oxygen as ordered
Four
Reassess pulse oximetry
Fifth
Institute actions to improve oxygenation
Sixth
Teach oxygen safety
(Rationale: Priority of actions includes the gathering of assessment information to reflect the patient’s respiratory condition. Once you have collected information, intervention can be initiated with application of oxygen if needed and subsequent reassessment of the pulse oximetry reading. Additional actions to improve client oxygenation and lung capacity can then be implemented with coughing, deep breathing, and use of incentive spirometry. Finally, once the patient experiences improvement in oxygenation and breathing status, reinforcement of oxygen education and safety measures would be appropriate).

incorrect.zh: 明确给出不同概念且未自行纠正才判错；没有给名称算遗漏。
incorrect.en: An explicitly different concept, unless corrected, is incorrect; no name is missing.

follow_up.zh: 请补充这一点：识别概念：不可分期压力性损伤。可以只补充这一点，无需重写之前的答案。
follow_up.en: Please add this point: Identify the concept: Unstageable pressure injuries. You can supplement your earlier answer without rewriting it.

criterion.zh: 指出腐肉或焦痂遮挡而无法确认深度
criterion.en: Describe tissue loss with depth obscured by slough or eschar

acceptable.zh: 全层损伤被腐肉/焦痂遮盖，深度无法确认均可；不用同时写两种遮挡物。
acceptable.en: Full-thickness loss with extent/depth obscured by either slough or eschar.

incorrect.zh: 不可分期不等于浅表损伤，也不能凭猜测赋具体分期。
incorrect.en: Unstageable does not mean superficial, and the obscured depth must not be guessed.

follow_up.zh: 请补充这一点：指出腐肉或焦痂遮挡而无法确认深度。可以只补充这一点，无需重写之前的答案。
follow_up.en: Please add this point: Describe tissue loss with depth obscured by slough or eschar. You can supplement your earlier answer without rewriting it.

optional_extensions.zh: 其他定义细节、机制、分期鉴别、治疗和完整护理计划可作拓展；不要要求复述题面全部内容。
optional_extensions.en: Other definition details, mechanisms, stage comparisons, treatment, and a full care plan are optional; do not require every detail of the supplied description.

openrn-skin-card-41.basis_question:
Full-thickness skin and tissue loss in which the extent of tissue damage within the ulcer cannot be confirmed because it is obscured by slough or eschar.

Name the concept described and briefly identify its key distinguishing feature.
